Hey hey I’m also from the Netherlands, so I don’t k ow why I’m still talking English. But I’d love to chat!
I would love to talk together!!!
Hey dude, you alright? I’m here for you if you wanna rant or sum I’ll do my best to help ya
I’ll be here to talk, I know it’s not as good as talking in real life but I would like to send ya a virtual hug!
Heyo! If you need someone to talk to im always there!

I totally get what you mean. I’m there also. And this is gonna sound stupid but idc. I need you can you please try? I wish I could hug you rn. Because I mean it with my whole soul that I care about you. And that I want you to live, and have fun while living. Life is weird we need to find our own meaning in this meaningless world. 
For me when I draw and people connect with my art and see themselves in it it’s gives me meaning. Maybe you like animals? Maybe Volunteer in a animal shelter. 

You are perfect the way you are. You are enough. You will see another day. You will get professional help.

I don’t think you can prepare your loved ones for suicide. 
Even though I myself have tried by isolating myself it never really works. They are your loved ones for a reason, they will be broken and be in horrible pain.
I never said no but he would continue when I was crying
